definition: a small room or cabinet for storage
description: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

en.question: What is the man standing on?

de.answer: Er steht auf einem Haufen Kleidung.
de.question: Worauf steht der Mann?

es.answer: Está de pie sobre un montón de ropa.
es.question: ¿Sobre qué está de pie el hombre?

fr.answer: Il se tient sur un tas de vêtements.
fr.question: Sur quoi l'homme se tient-il ?
